articles.title: A Girl, a Lost Lamby, and a Talking Octopus: This Movie Brings Sculptures to Life!
articles.summary: A short film called "Goodnight Lamby" uses Google's AI to make artist Dustin Yellin's glass sculptures move. His daughter Zia stars, searching for her stuffed animal inside his art. Paul Rudd and Chris Rock help out!

articles.title: What If the Soviets Won the Moon Race? A New Show Spies on Their Secret Space City!
articles.summary: Apple TV's "Star City" imagines the Soviet side of the space race if they had landed on the moon first. The show follows cosmonauts, engineers, and spies training at a real base outside Moscow. It's a spinoff of "For All Mankind."

articles.title: Coach Taylor Said No to a Movie! Secrets from the 'Friday Night Lights' Reunion
articles.summary: At a 20th anniversary reunion, Kyle Chandler revealed he turned down a "Friday Night Lights" movie right after winning an Emmy. The cast also shared funny and tough memories, including a terrible Season 2 murder plot. A reboot isn't coming soon.
